necessary_context.content: F(x)=(1/m) sum_i f_i(x), m>=2, on a closed convex X subset of R^d. Eq.(2) returns component value, gradient/subgradient and prox; Eq.(3) defines prox by minimizing f_i(u)+(beta/2)||x-u||^2 over u in X.
necessary_context.name: Finite sum and component Oracle

necessary_context.content: The parameter beta multiplies the quadratic penalty: f^(beta)(x)=inf_{u in X}[f(u)+(beta/2)||x-u||^2]. Lemma 1 states beta-smoothness, gradient beta(x-prox_f(x,beta)), and bias at most L^2/(2beta) for x in X.
necessary_context.name: Moreau envelope convention

necessary_context.content: Eq.(5) averages the component envelopes; the paper explicitly distinguishes this average from the envelope of F. Section 3 selects beta=L^2/epsilon and an epsilon/2 inner optimization tolerance.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.4, Eq.(5) and following paragraph
necessary_context.name: Component smoothing
